paragraphs: Friend, here's the big idea: God didn't stay far away and shout instructions at us. The Word, who was with God and was God, "became flesh and made His dwelling among us" (John 1:14). He moved in, friend. And no one has ever seen God, but the Son "has made Him known" (John 1:18), so if you want to know what God is like, you look at Jesus.

Now here's the part that gets me every time. The one who made the world walked into it, and "the world did not recognize Him" (John 1:10), and His own didn't receive Him either (John 1:11). But the Light was never in danger, because "the darkness has not overcome it" (John 1:5). Nothing you or I or anybody else does can put that Light out.

And look at what He hands out to people who receive Him: "the right to become children of God" (John 1:12). CHILDREN, friend. You don't earn it by your own effort, because they are "born of God" (John 1:13). Even a worn-out old stamper like me got lifted out of the dark, so this one is for you too, and "from His fullness we have all received grace upon grace" (John 1:16).
